en-US.longDescription: CompleteFTP is a high performance Windows file server supporting secure file transfer via FTPS (FTP over SSL), SFTP (FTP over SSH), HTTP, HTTPS, SCP and SSH. CompleteFTP also supports web applications written in Javascript, and collaborative file sharing.
en-US.name: Complete FTP

zh-CN.description: 适用于 Windows 的安全文件服务器
